name: Ice Storm Sapphire (Minor Artifact)
body:
Aura strong evocation; Slot none; CL 20th; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This large azure jewel glows with an inner white light. You can use the gem to cast ice storm a number of times per day that depends on the season.

Damage also varies based on the season. You must make a successful DC 20 Fortitude saving throw when using the gem or take 1d6 cold damage.

Season	Number of Uses	Ice Storm Damage
Winter	3	3d6 bludgeoning and 6d6 cold damage in 40-foot-radius
Spring	2	3d6 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage in 30-foot-radius
Summer	1	2d6 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage in 20-foot-radius
Autumn	2	3d6 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage in 30-foot-radius
